messages.subject: fetch new data from googlesheet on actionbutton

Hi,

I am trying to wire up an action button on my ui.R for the user to fire it up in order to fetch new data from a googlesheet and then use that data in the entire app. Each time this button is fired, all of the formulas and functions should be recalculated based on this new data.

library(shiny)
library(leaflet)
library(googlesheets)
shinyServer(function(input, output, session) {
 
  fetcheddata <- reactive({
    mybutton <- input$fetchnew
    if (is.null(mybutton)) return (NULL)
    mydata <- gs_read(gs_key("abcdefghijkabcdefghijkabcdefghijkabcdefghijk"))
    mydata$latitude <- as.numeric(ptsdata$latitude)
    mydata$longitude <- as.numeric(ptsdata$longitude)
    mydata
  })
  output$draw <- renderTable(
    fetcheddata()
   )
 

and on the ui.R side, I have a line for the button:

actionButton("fetchnew", "Fetch New Data")


why am I doing this? because when new data is added to the speadsheet, they don't show up on the running shiny app session. I have to wait for that session to go to sleep and then run the app to see the new data.

My app is based on the superzip shiny app, so there is another reactive expressions afterwards.
I need the community's suggestions to set this up.
thank you in advance
